item.title: Top Mamdani Pick Out After Single Day On Job As Antisemitic Past Resurfaces
item.description: A top aide to socialist New York City Mayor-elect Zohran Mamdani resigned Thursday with just one day on the job, after past antisemitic and anti-police comments on her social media were exposed.

item.title: Ex-Convict Rapper Who Zohran Mamdani Tapped Can’t Seem To Pronounce Mayor-Elect’s Last Name
item.description: Rapper Mysonne Linen, who served seven years in state prison for armed robbery, repeatedly mispronounced New York City Mayor-elect Zohran Mamdani's last name during a Friday interview on "The Breakfast Club."

item.title: Biden Admin Shoveled Billions Out The Door With Poor Oversight, Internal Watchdog Says
item.description: The Environmental Protection Agency's (EPA) Office of the Inspector General (OIG) found in a recent audit that former President Joe Biden's administration did not adequately protect more than $22 billion in taxpayer dollars.

item.title: Cynthia Lummis To Not Seek Reelection
item.description: Republican Wyoming Sen. Cynthia Lummis announced Friday afternoon she would not seek reelection in 2026.

item.title: Elise Stefanik Suddenly Ends Campaign For New York Governor
item.description: Republican New York Rep. Elise Stefanik abruptly suspended her campaign Friday afternoon to unseat Democratic New York Gov. Kathy Hochul.

item.title: Teen Gangsters Plead Guilty To Serving As Hitmen For Deadly Drug Cartel
item.description: Two teenage gang members pleaded guilty in federal court Thursday to murder and attempted murder charges after admitting they served as hired hitmen for Mexico’s Sinaloa Cartel.
